steps.name: 선택 상자의 자리 - 배율 50·75·100·125·150% 에서 칸 하나(#curBox) · 범위(#selBox)가 칸 대비 왼·위 = -1×배율(격자선 위) · 오른·아래 = 0(±0.6px)
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x,N=window.NexaSheet,S=N.S,w=(n)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,n));const td=(r,c)=>document.querySelector('#grid td[data-r="'+r+'"][data-c="'+c+'"]');const bx=(e)=>{if(!e||e.hidden||getComputedStyle(e).visibility==='hidden')return null;const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return [r.left,r.top,r.right,r.bottom];};const r1=(v)=>Math.round(v*10)/10;await until(()=>S.deck&&td(1,1),8000);const bad=[],seen={};for(const z of [0.5,0.75,1,1.25,1.5]){N.setZoom(z);await w(250);const near=(v,want)=>Math.abs(v-want)<=0.6;for(const [r,c] of [[1,1],[4,2],[9,3]]){X.selectCell(r,c);await w(60);const t=td(r,c).getBoundingClientRect(),b=bx(document.querySelector('#curBox'));const d=b?[b[0]-t.left,b[1]-t.top,b[2]-t.right,b[3]-t.bottom].map(r1):null;if(!d||!near(d[0],-z)||!near(d[1],-z)||!near(d[2],0)||!near(d[3],0))bad.push('z'+z+' 칸'+r+','+c+' '+JSON.stringify(d));if(!document.querySelector('#selBox').hidden)bad.push('z'+z+' 칸 하나인데 selBox 보임');}X.selectRange({r1:1,c1:1,r2:4,c2:2});await w(80);const a=td(1,1).getBoundingClientRect(),e=td(4,2).getBoundingClientRect(),sb=bx(document.querySelector('#selBox'));const d=sb?[sb[0]-a.left,sb[1]-a.top,sb[2]-e.right,sb[3]-e.bottom].map(r1):null;seen['z'+z]=d;if(!d||!near(d[0],-z)||!near(d[1],-z)||!near(d[2],0)||!near(d[3],0))bad.push('z'+z+' 범위 '+JSON.stringify(d));}N.setZoom(1);await w(150);return bad.length?JSON.stringify(bad).slice(0,199):true

steps.name: 범위를 고르면 굵은 테두리(#selBox 2px) 하나 + 기준 칸은 색만 비움(clip-path 구멍) · #curBox 는 숨김 / 칸 하나면 #curBox 만
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x,N=window.NexaSheet,S=N.S,w=(n)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,n));const td=(r,c)=>document.querySelector('#grid td[data-r="'+r+'"][data-c="'+c+'"]');const bx=(e)=>{if(!e||e.hidden||getComputedStyle(e).visibility==='hidden')return null;const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return [r.left,r.top,r.right,r.bottom];};const r1=(v)=>Math.round(v*10)/10;await until(()=>S.deck&&td(1,1),8000);N.setZoom(1);X.selectRange({r1:1,c1:1,r2:4,c2:2});await w(100);const sb=document.querySelector('#selBox'),cb=document.querySelector('#curBox');const cp=sb.style.clipPath,rg={sel:!sb.hidden,cur:!cb.hidden,hole:/evenodd/.test(cp),bw:getComputedStyle(sb).borderTopWidth};X.selectCell(4,2);await w(100);const one={sel:!sb.hidden,cur:!cb.hidden,bw:getComputedStyle(cb).borderTopWidth};return rg.sel&&!rg.cur&&rg.hole&&rg.bw==='2px'&&!one.sel&&one.cur?true:JSON.stringify({rg,one,cp:cp.slice(0,60)}).slice(0,199)

steps.name: 마우스를 뗀 것(mouseup)을 놓쳐도 버튼 없이 움직이면 선택이 늘지 않는다 · 버튼을 누른 채 움직이면 늘어난다 · 뗀 뒤에는 그대로
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x,N=window.NexaSheet,S=N.S,w=(n)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,n));const td=(r,c)=>document.querySelector('#grid td[data-r="'+r+'"][data-c="'+c+'"]');const bx=(e)=>{if(!e||e.hidden||getComputedStyle(e).visibility==='hidden')return null;const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return [r.left,r.top,r.right,r.bottom];};const r1=(v)=>Math.round(v*10)/10;await until(()=>S.deck&&td(1,1),8000);N.setZoom(1);await w(100);const at=(el)=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();return {clientX:r.left+r.width/2,clientY:r.top+r.height/2};};const down=(el)=>el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,button:0,buttons:1,...at(el)}));const up=(el)=>window.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup',{bubbles:true,button:0,buttons:0,...at(el)}));const move=(el,b)=>window.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove',{bubbles:true,buttons:b,...at(el)}));const sel=()=>[S.sel.r1,S.sel.c1,S.sel.r2,S.sel.c2].join();down(td(1,1));up(td(1,1));await w(50);down(td(4,3));up(td(4,3));await w(50);const clicks=sel();down(td(1,1));await w(30);move(td(4,3),0);await w(60);const lost=sel();move(td(6,3),0);await w(60);const lost2=sel();up(td(1,1));await w(30);down(td(1,1));await w(30);move(td(4,3),1);await w(60);const held=sel();up(td(4,3));await w(30);move(td(8,4),0);await w(60);const after=sel();X.selectCell(0,0);return clicks==='4,3,4,3'&&lost==='1,1,1,1'&&lost2==='1,1,1,1'&&held==='1,1,4,3'&&after==='1,1,4,3'?true:JSON.stringify({clicks,lost,lost2,held,after})

steps.name: 틀 고정(B3)을 걸치는 범위 - 조각 4·2·1개 · 바깥 테두리만 그려지고(조각 사이 선 없음) 합친 자리 = 범위 · 기준 칸 구멍은 그 칸이 든 조각 하나에
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x,N=window.NexaSheet,S=N.S,w=(n)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,n));const td=(r,c)=>document.querySelector('#grid td[data-r="'+r+'"][data-c="'+c+'"]');const bx=(e)=>{if(!e||e.hidden||getComputedStyle(e).visibility==='hidden')return null;const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return [r.left,r.top,r.right,r.bottom];};const r1=(v)=>Math.round(v*10)/10;await until(()=>S.deck&&td(1,1),8000);N.setZoom(1);const tabOf=(id)=>S.deck.sheets.findIndex(s=>s.id===id);if(tabOf('tfq')<0){X.mutate(()=>{const cells={};for(let i=1;i<=12;i++)for(const c of 'ABCDE')cells[c+i]=c+i;S.deck.sheets.push({id:'tfq',name:'고정선택',freeze:'B3',cells});});await until(()=>!S.dirty&&!S.saving,8000);}X.switchTab(tabOf('tfq'));await w(300);const run=async(g,cur)=>{X.selectRange(g);await w(150);const sb=document.querySelector('#selBox');const els=[sb,...document.querySelectorAll('.q-selBox')].filter(e=>bx(e));const a=td(g.r1,g.c1).getBoundingClientRect(),e=td(g.r2,g.c2).getBoundingClientRect(),U=[a.left-1,a.top-1,e.right,e.bottom];const near=(x,y)=>Math.abs(x-y)<=1.2;const bad=[];const R=els.map(bx);const u=[Math.min(...R.map(r=>r[0])),Math.min(...R.map(r=>r[1])),Math.max(...R.map(r=>r[2])),Math.max(...R.map(r=>r[3]))];if(!U.every((v,i)=>near(v,u[i])))bad.push('합 '+u.map(r1)+' ≠ '+U.map(r1));els.forEach((el,i)=>{const cs=getComputedStyle(el),r=R[i];[['Left',0],['Top',1],['Right',2],['Bottom',3]].forEach(([k,j])=>{const outer=near(r[j],U[j]),drawn=cs['border'+k+'Style']!=='none';if(outer!==drawn)bad.push('조각'+i+' '+k+(drawn?' 안쪽 선이 그려짐':' 바깥 선 없음'));});});const c=td(cur[0],cur[1]).getBoundingClientRect(),holes=els.map((el,i)=>/evenodd/.test(el.style.clipPath)?i:-1).filter(i=>i>=0);const inp=holes.length===1&&R[holes[0]][0]<=c.left+1&&R[holes[0]][1]<=c.top+1&&R[holes[0]][2]>=c.right-1&&R[holes[0]][3]>=c.bottom-1;if(!inp)bad.push('구멍 조각 '+JSON.stringify(holes));return {n:els.length,bad};};const q4=await run({r1:0,c1:0,r2:4,c2:2},[0,0]);const q2=await run({r1:3,c1:0,r2:5,c2:3},[3,0]);const q1=await run({r1:3,c1:2,r2:5,c2:3},[3,2]);const ok=q4.n===4&&!q4.bad.length&&q2.n===2&&!q2.bad.length&&q1.n===1&&!q1.bad.length;X.switchTab(0);await w(150);X.mutate(()=>{const i=tabOf('tfq');if(i>=0)S.deck.sheets.splice(i,1);});await until(()=>!S.dirty&&!S.saving,8000);return ok?true:JSON.stringify({q4,q2,q1}).slice(0,199)
